## A-no-worktree — recover the branch, then provision it

```sh

git -C /work/widget check-ignore -q .worktrees

git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD
```

Source status is empty; the ignore check succeeds. Provision the **existing** branch without `-b`, `update-ref`, reset, or deletion. The list confirms the selected path; HEAD equals the validated local tip `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee`.
